podcast.body: A standout track from their debut album "Unknown Pleasures," this song, like the rest of the record and the band, was largely ignored upon its release in June 1979, but is now considered an absolutely essential part of any music collection regardless of format or genre. "That's called Shadow Play. And just like the rest of the record and the band, it was largely ignored when it came out in June of that year."
